usage: The phrase '我肚痛' is used to express that you are experiencing stomach pain.
It combines the pronoun '我' (I) with the noun '肚痛' (stomachache).
It can stand alone as a complete sentence when talking about your health.
You can use it when explaining your symptoms to a doctor or friend.
To describe other people's stomachache, change '我' to the appropriate pronoun.
